title: Noise expectation of a linear form
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$, and let $a=(a_i)_{i=0}^{n-1}\in\mathbb{R}^n$. Independently in each coordinate, retain $x_i$ with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and otherwise replace it by $-x_i$, producing a random sign vector $Y$. The expected value of the linear form $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}a_iY_i$ is $\rho\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}a_ix_i$.
